services.name: Register as a designated caregiver
services.description: Certified patients may designate up to five caregivers, who are registered automatically when the patient names them, and can then buy, carry and help administer medical cannabis for the patient.
services.eligibility: The certified patient designates the caregiver; caregiver age and other rules are on the OCM page.

coverage.value: New York State Medical Cannabis Program.

evidence.value: Certified patients registered with the Medical Cannabis Program may designate up to five caregivers; a caregiver named on the patient registration is auto-registered.

services.name: Register a facility as a designated caregiver
services.description: Hospitals, nursing and adult care facilities, mental health and developmental disability residences, youth residential programs and schools can apply to OCM to act as a designated caregiver for patients in their care.
services.eligibility: For eligible facility types listed by OCM.

coverage.value: New York State Medical Cannabis Program.

evidence.value: A facility may apply to become an OCM-approved designated caregiver facility; eligible types include hospitals, residential health care and adult care facilities, mental health and developmental disability residences, youth residential programs and schools.

services.name: Register to certify patients (health care providers)
services.description: Licensed practitioners complete an approved course of at least two hours and then certify patients through the state Medical Cannabis Data Management System.
services.eligibility: For licensed practitioners eligible to certify under New York rules.

coverage.value: New York State Medical Cannabis Program.

evidence.value: A minimum of a 2-hour approved course must be completed by providers who certify patients, who then certify through the Medical Cannabis Data Management System in the Health Commerce System.

services.name: Medicaid coverage of certification visits
services.description: New York Medicaid covers practitioner office visits to evaluate and certify a patient for medical cannabis; the cannabis products themselves are not covered.
services.eligibility: For New York Medicaid members seeing a Medicaid-participating practitioner.

coverage.value: New York State Medical Cannabis Program.

evidence.value: Medical cannabis products are not a covered benefit under New York State Medicaid; practitioner office visits for evaluation and certification are.

services.name: Buying medical cannabis in New York with another state's card
services.description: Medical patients certified or registered in another U.S. state may buy medical cannabis products in New York by showing that proof with a government photo ID.
services.eligibility: Bring proof of certification or registration from your state and a government photo ID.

coverage.value: New York State Medical Cannabis Program.

evidence.value: Medical cannabis patients from other U.S. jurisdictions may now purchase medical cannabis products in New York (2026 amendments).
Out-of-state patients may purchase provided they present proof of a certification, registration or the equivalent for their state.

services.name: Know your rights as a certified patient
services.description: OCM explains protections for certified patients in employment, housing and family court, including that status as a certified patient cannot be held against you in family court or social services cases.
services.eligibility: For certified patients; specific situations may have exceptions described by OCM.

coverage.value: New York State Medical Cannabis Program.

evidence.value: You cannot be fired for your status as a certified medical cannabis patient; in domestic violence, social services or family court cases that status cannot be held against you.

services.name: NORML's New York medical cannabis law guide
services.description: National patient and consumer advocacy group's overview of New York medical cannabis laws and regulations for patients.
services.eligibility: Free to read; an advocacy summary, not legal advice.

coverage.value: New York State Medical Cannabis Program.

evidence.value: NORML provides an overview of the medical cannabis laws and regulations for patients in New York; the page was last modified September 22, 2026.
